# BAD-022 — Make the CI smoke job a required check once it has run green

## Brief
Branch protection on BadTakes main requires only the Gate check, so the new ci.yml smoke job (BAD-009) reports a red run on a PR without blocking the merge; Spud's landing waits only for required checks, so a broken app boot would still land. ci.yml is path-filtered, which is why Gate exists: requiring smoke directly would strand docs-only PRs, so the change needs either a required check that tolerates a skipped job or a Gate that needs smoke.

Evidence: gh api repos/0snug0/BadTakes/branches/main/protection/required_status_checks -> contexts: [Gate]; gate.yml has no needs: and its header explains why filtered checks cannot be required.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer on opus: a single workflow change (ci.yml absorbs Gate as a filter-free aggregator job needing smoke and test, gate.yml retired) plus the docs that name Gate. Ordinary CI config, no separable parts. Eric chose smoke + test (Linux) as blocking; test-windows and warm-ffmpeg stay advisory. Precondition met: smoke ran green on main in run 34913942216.

## Outcome
Landed as https://github.com/0snug0/BadTakes/pull/338 (squash-merged 2026-09-14 18:32 PT as b8338a2). Gate is now a job inside ci.yml that needs changes, test and smoke and runs with always(), so it reports on every PR (docs-only included, where the gated jobs skip and pass) while a red smoke or test fails it; gate.yml is deleted and branch protection still requires the one Gate context. Proof: PR 338's own run 34916387852 passed changes, test, smoke, test-windows and Gate; the post-merge push run 34917691372 on main is green.
